violated_contract: Every workflow_dispatch prod deploy validates its release SHA with git cat-file -e "<full-40-hex-SHA>^{commit}" (and peels the same form for source-SHA admission in the pusher lane). git 2.54 runner images regressed peeling ^{commit} off a full 40-hex SHA: the expression now fails with 'Not a valid object name'/'ambiguous argument' even when the commit object is present in the pack (repro'd on a clean clone: abbreviated SHA peels fine, bare full SHA resolves, full-SHA+peel fails). First production hit 2026-10-10T09:15Z, run 38040612226, deterministic across two dispatches; every merge-commit release_sha deploy is blocked fleet-wide until fixed.
canonical_prevention: Never peel ^{commit} off a full-length literal SHA in CI; check existence and type directly with [ "$(git cat-file -t "$SHA" 2>/dev/null)" = "commit" ], which is version-stable and identical in admission semantics. Peel only refs or abbreviated SHAs (still supported), and keep a canary deploy of each deploy workflow on runner-image rollouts.
